messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: routing.fallback.errors high spike detected for prod-us-west. Escalation level: P1. Notifying on-call.

paul-oncall: saw it. getting into the runbook now. what metrics are spiking?

sasha: errors are 5xx from routing-service when falling back to model-variant 'm4-small-quant'. Failure rate ~60% for last 3m. latency also up.

diego: looks like a recent config push to routing-policy-schema bumped default behavior. I think deprecated field `use_legacy_fallback` got ignored, defaulting to new fallback chain that picks region-first before variant.

emma: can you paste the config diff?

diego: here's the snippet from the deploy:```yaml
routing_policy:
  default_strategy: "cost-aware"
  # legacy field removed in 2024-11 migration
  use_legacy_fallback: true
  fallbacks:
    - region: us-west-2
      variants:
        - m4-small-quant
        - m4-small
```

paul-oncall: if the new schema treats unknown/deprecated fields as NOOP, maybe fallback ordering changed. I see many requests routed to the quant variant which is failing. Can we short-circuit?

mike: we can flip a runtime flag to prefer "variant-stable" before region fallback. Doing it now on routing-service-prod-us-west.

incident-bot: deploy started by mike at 2087654450. CI check ok.

ana: small correction: the runtime flag is `routing.override_order = "variant,region"`. mike, are you applying to all shards?

mike: applying to the three affected shards first: shard-02, shard-03, shard-07. patch applied to shard-02. observing.

sasha: shard-02 error rate dropped from 58% -> 6% within 30s. good signal.

diego: roll-forward the override to the other shards, and also start a rollback of the policy schema deploy that introduced the deprecated field parsing change.

paul-oncall: rolling to shard-03 and 07 now. please post confirmations. I'm paging runtime lead.

emma: tagging product for customer impact: @ana we have degraded responses for several large customers using us-west. Are any customer-facing incidents open?

ana: I'm on it. running impact query... looks like 4 customers reported increased error traces in the last 10m, top one is acme-corp. Their LLM-powered chat is failing -> visible in their logs.

paul-oncall: creating incident ticket INC-20876 and adding customer bridge.

incident-bot: incident INC-20876 created by paul-oncall. bridge: https://meet.example/INC-20876

mike: shard-03 and 07 patches complete. error rates back to baseline across all three.

sasha: thanks. next steps: revert schema change commit that caused deprecated-field-to-default-behavior, add schema migration guard, and add canary to routing-policy changes.

diego: Agreed. I'll open PR to add a validation error when deprecated fields are present instead of silently ignoring them. Also propose a rollout flag to force explicit opt-in for legacy behavior.

emma: for communication: Ana, please update acme-corp with initial status: we mitigated by changing runtime fallback order; followup will include root cause and timeline.

ana: message sent to customers, linking bridge. They have engineers joining.

paul-oncall: handing off to night oncall @sasha in 30m. I'll stay on bridge for handover for 15m. If anything spikes, escalate to eng-runtime channel.

sasha: I'll own overnight. please add runbook steps to the incident doc: how to flip `routing.override_order` and where to find shards.

diego: added runbook snippet to the ticket:```bash
# emergency override
curl -X POST https://routing-api.prod/config/override -d '{"override_order":"variant,region"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```

paul-oncall: pushing postmortem template and assigning owners: RCAs to diego (schema), mike (runtime patch), ana (customer comms).

incident-bot: incident INC-20876 status: mitigated -> monitoring.

paul-oncall: closing pager for now. leaving bridge open for 60m monitoring, then will move to postmortem. awesome work team. :thumbsup:

sasha: noted. I'll check metric dashboards hourly.

ana: customers confirmed degraded UX improved. will schedule follow-up call with acme-corp for 10:00 PDT tomorrow.

mike: filing a quick changelog note: avoid silent acceptance of deprecated routing fields. will prep canary gates.

paul-oncall: thanks everyone. handover complete.
